problem:

Question 2
?

Consider the first-order linear ODE dydx−5y=(2x−7)cos⁡(x). According to the method of variation of parameters, which of the following is a suitable ansatz for the particular solution yp(x)?

a
yp(x)=u(x)ex
b
yp(x)=u(x)e5x
c
yp(x)=u(x)e−x
d
yp(x)=u(x)e6x
e
yp(x)=u(x)e−5x
